html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · July 28, 2022

On Jul 19, 2022, intelligent-sales vendor Zhongke Shuke (中科数科) (founded 2020) closed a multi-¥10M Series A led by Donghai Investment — for data modeling, systems, and talent across entertainment, telco, and ecom. Full-cycle digital closed loop (portrait acquisition → intelligent touch → lifecycle CRM → private-domain ops) vs point solutions (telco CDP + iFlytek voice + SalesEasy CRM + SCRM). Core products include Yuncong CDP. Revenue share on post-delivery margin uplift; finance vertical alone ~¥400M rev / ¥150M GP annually. Controllers: Qianhai Zhongke Jingwei 45.9%.

— END —
